content.title: About
content.content: Sunny D is a non‑alcoholic fruit beverage based on orange juice, fortified with vitamins and minerals. It was first launched in the United States in 1963 and has become popular with children and adults thanks to its bright taste and iconic orange packaging.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Originally the drink was called "Sunny Delight" and was sold only as a concentrate.
In the 1990s Sunny D became one of the best‑selling fruit drinks in the US.
The formula often includes added vitamins A, C and D, as well as calcium.
In some countries the drink is sold under localized names but retains its characteristic orange color.
Sunny D is frequently used in recipes for cocktails, ice cream and desserts.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Provides vitamin C, which supports the immune system and aids iron absorption.

items.title: Vitamin A
items.content: Vitamin A is important for vision and skin health.

items.title: Calcium
items.content: Added calcium helps maintain strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Quick Energy
items.content: Contains simple sugars that deliver fast energy, convenient for active kids.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Mostly water, contributing to overall fluid balance.

items.title: High Sugar Content
items.content: Sugar may contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of dental caries when consumed frequently.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Flavorings and preservatives in the formula can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic pH may irritate sensitive teeth and stomach.

items.title: Not a Substitute for Whole Fruit Juice
items.content: Although fortified, the drink does not provide all the nutrients found in fresh fruit juices.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Sunny D chilled in a glass, often over ice. It can be used as a base for fruit cocktails, smoothies, ice cream, or in culinary recipes such as frosting for baked goods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened Sunny D in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
